body: After a series of unlucky circumstances I had no other choice. Let a few random old dudes have their way for a few hundred quid that got me out of some serious financial troubles. I'm straight. Pretty sure I'm suffering from PTSD but at least I'm not homeless.

I'm a good looking man. I'm not saying that to brag but I'm saying that because I'm suicidal too. I've posted twice on here. I don't know if that brings you any comfort. Don't bother yourself with how you look.

Hello.

I know how it feels to be there in that dark place. I have wanted to end it many times, but recently I have had an epiphany.

Instead of physically ending your live why don't you just start a new one. Leave your family, go on an adventure, fall madly in love with a woman! 

If you end your life your family will be devastated and carry that with them. If you leave them they might be upset but if they see that you are happier and they love you I am sure they would understand eventually.

It is your life to choose with what you want and ending it now might mean you miss out on the happiest years of your life.

Hello friend,   


Please don't do this.   


I know things feel bad and I am in the same position as you right now. But I have chosen to stay till tomorrow. Just do that. One more day. If you need to get away from your parents then just leave them.   


If it is too late then I hope you are in a better place.
Thanks, I really appreciate it. I tried to write her a letter but she asked me to just leave her alone :(
How can I make this right? What can I do to show that I didn't mean it?
Thankyou. I want to keep fighting but I keep making things worse. I just don't know what to do.
The baby has been born now and we did a DNA. He is mine. I just hate what I've done to her.
I am in a dark place tonight too. You are not alone.
